limitations: The original 6x10, 10x10 and 10x14 m rectangles are nominal size references, not complete art bounds: roof/eaves and porch extend outside while some interior areas are transparent. Use placement_envelope_px for conservative art clearance in presentation scenes; precise wall collision/navigation requires an authored game shape. The source art does not yet satisfy a strict rectangular physical-footprint contract.

The southern brown facade panels are stylized wall details, not visibly open doors. Entrance ports denote exterior interaction thresholds at the south wall; navigation openings require explicit game logic/door art in a later scope.
Field-to-grass blending is an outer property-polygon geometry mask, not a per-tile border asset. No separate runtime transition PNG is included.

source_correction_summary.reason: v1 mixed field adjacency showed a straight 8 m grid at 320 px proof; building roof-fill and doorway claims overstated actual raster; access proof did not connect road to entrance

access_chain_contract.canonical_port: building entrance_px is exterior south threshold; approach travels south from that point
access_chain_contract.driveway_axes: driveway_short and driveway_long axis_endpoints_px remain authoritative; long axis spans 8 m and short 4 m at 32 px/m
access_chain_contract.placement_rule: Overlap transparent access assets at their physical endpoints; draw grass, road, driveway, yard, threshold wear, then building. Preserve source pixel sizes and use no forced nonuniform scale.
access_chain_contract.short_driveway_use: substitute driveway_short for closer road/door separations; its 4 m axis endpoints are in access_overlays metadata; inspect connection geometry before placement
